# Ultrastable

> The platform: all code, rules, doctrine, the website, the dashboard and the seed/ kernel are written here and nowhere else.

It reads its own measures, files the next improvement, hands it to its executor, merges, deploys, probes the result live and scores the prediction, for itself and for every system it runs.

## Live

- [Ultrastable](https://ultrastable.io/): the running system
- [Health report](https://ultrastable.io/health): the result of its last tick
- [Statements](https://ultrastable.io/claims.json): what it states, and the endpoint behind each statement
- [llms.txt](https://ultrastable.io/llms.txt): the index the running system serves, with every route it answers

## Start here

- [README.md](README.md): what it is, where it runs and how it runs
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): instructions for any coding agent
- [ultrastable.json](ultrastable.json): the manifest this file, the README blocks, CITATION.cff, publiccode.yml and codemeta.json are rendered from
- [codemeta.json](codemeta.json): software metadata (CodeMeta 3.0)
